description.value: A family-owned business operating for over 45 years on Nitinaht Lake on the west coast of Vancouver Island, Nitinat Wilderness Charters sits in the heart of the famous West Coast Trail corridor. They offer cabin rentals directly on the WCT at the Nitinaht Narrows (km 32.5), tent deck space, room rentals in Nitinaht Village, water taxi service to and from the WCT, and a seasonal Crabshack restaurant. This is a key resupply and rest node for anyone completing or cycling near the West Coast Trail.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is available and detailed. The business is a family-owned operation on Nitinaht Lake offering water taxi, cabin rentals (4 cabins on the West Coast Trail at Nitinaht Narrows), room rentals (3 rooms in Nitinaht Village), a seasonal Crabshack restaurant, and sightseeing tours. Tent deck space rental is explicitly mentioned, confirming camping-adjacent use. No specific amenity details (showers, toilets, water, etc.) are mentioned for the camping/tent areas on the website.
concerns: Website copyright reads ©2021 — site may not have been updated recently, but business appears operational based on content detail
No physical address in OSM tags; GPS coordinates place it near Nitinaht Lake but address cannot be confirmed
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating business with a detailed website, confirmed phone/email contact, and accommodation/camping options directly on the West Coast Trail — highly relevant to touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: Two distinct accommodation locations: Nitinaht Village (room rentals, near WCT registration) and Nitinaht Narrows km 32.5 (cabins and tent decks, on the WCT itself). Cash payments preferred across all services.
